krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha.intro_seo: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana Odisha: tuition and hostel fee support for children of CM-KISAN farmers in medical, engineering, nursing and other courses.
krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha._reviewed: 2026-10-21 (CNT-112): the old text said 'up to ₹10,000/year', which no source supports. Official press release (Odisha Information & Public Relations, 28-03-2025): fee support, actual course fee in government institutions, capped per course in private ones (B.Tech ₹60,000, M.Tech ₹66,000, MBA ₹65,000, medical 4-5 yrs ₹37,950, B.Pharma ₹35,000, nursing ₹19,450, 2-yr medical ₹58,000, architecture ₹60,000), for sons/daughters of CM-KISAN beneficiaries. 2026-10-23 (CNT-114): the official Notification of the Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment (No. DAFP-TRG-CMKI-0003-2024/34141, 27-09-2024) confirms the amounts on the page: private-institute yearly amounts run from Rs 5,000 (ITI/ITC) up to Rs 77,895 (B.V.Sc & A.H., OUAT) in Annexure-1; premier government institutes (NIT, IIT, IIM, AIIMS, ICAR, inside and outside Odisha) get the actual fee or at most Rs 1.00 lakh, whichever is less; hostel/mess Rs 1,200 a month (UG, PG, PhD, premier) or Rs 1,000 (diploma, polytechnic, ITI) for 10 months; no private institution outside Odisha is allowed. Portal opens twice a year (July-August, November-December). amount_annual 100000 and amount_min 5000 are therefore correct and left as they are.
krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha.deadline_description: The State Scholarship Portal opens twice a year, in July-August and in November-December, for new and renewal applications. The department can change these dates.

inspire-scholarship-for-higher-education.step_guide:
To apply for the INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE), follow these steps:

1.  **Registration:** Visit the official INSPIRE web portal: `https://online-inspire.gov.in`. Click on 'New User? Register Here' to create an account. You will need a valid email ID, which will serve as your login ID.
2.  **Login & Fill Application:** After verifying your email, log in using your registered email ID and password. Navigate to the 'Scholarship' section and select the 'INSPIRE-SHE' scholarship option. Carefully fill in all required personal, academic (Class 10th and 12th details, current educational information), and contact details.
3.  **Upload Documents:** Scan and upload the mandatory documents, including a passport-size photograph, Class 10th Marksheet/Certificate (for date of birth), Class 12th Marksheet, Endorsement Certificate (signed by Principal/Director/Registrar in the prescribed format), proof of admission in a science course, and the first page of your SBI bank passbook (for DBT transfer, Aadhaar-linked).
4.  **Review and Submit:** Cross-check all entered details for accuracy before submitting the application. Save the acknowledgment slip for future reference.
5.  **Status Tracking:** To check your application status, log in to the portal using your Login ID and Password, and then enter your Application Reference Number on your dashboard.

*Note:* No application call is open right now. DST says INSPIRE-SHE is being redesigned and the call is delayed, with no date announced. The steps above show the portal process from earlier calls; check the INSPIRE online portal for any official notice.
